assumptions: The three source array axes remain unchanged and are named I,J,K as neutral Nibabel voxel-index axes bound to the affine; no transpose, reorientation, or resampling is performed. Mapping I,J,K into VoxelScope synthetic Z,Y,X naming and traversal is a later explicit adapter gate and remains unresolved.

PyTorch and NumPy float32 reduction order is not assumed to be byte-identical; exact bytes are recorded, while acceptance uses the preregistered rtol 0.000002 and atol 0.00002 without post-execution relaxation.
observed_behavior: The pinned LoadImaged constructor delegates to LoadImage with dtype float32 by default and passes a list-valued image entry to that loader in caller-provided order.

The pinned NibabelReader defaults as_closest_canonical to false, reads each filename with nibabel, obtains scaled array data through np.asanyarray(img.dataobj, order=C), verifies compatible affine and spatial shape metadata, and stacks channel-less images on a new first axis.
The pinned LoadImage casts the stacked reader result to its default float32 dtype after reader data extraction.

The pinned NormalizeIntensityd delegates to NormalizeIntensity, which converts the input to a tensor, normalizes each first-axis channel independently, selects nonzero values, computes float32 mean and population standard deviation, and writes normalized values only at selected positions.
MONAI returns an all-zero channel unchanged and substitutes divisor one for zero variance; this adapter deliberately tightens both cases to refusal before private execution.
The pinned model inference configuration contains LoadImaged followed by NormalizeIntensityd with nonzero true and channel_wise true, and contains no orientation or spacing transform.
